card.name: A or next before a dose
card.fires_on: The small words "a" or "next" right before "dose" (new, repeat, replacement, next) in instructions about vomiting or missed doses. Rarely a number such as 1 or 2 before a unit.

modes.label: a before new dose
modes.description: The article "a" before new, repeat or replacement dose after vomiting.
modes.example: If vomiting occurs within 30 minutes after administration, administer<< a>> new dose.

modes.label: next before dose
modes.description: The word "next" before dose or scheduled injection, in dosing-schedule instructions.
modes.example: If vomiting occurs any time after taking BALVERSA, the<< next>> dose should be taken the next day.

modes.label: number before amount
modes.description: A stray digit starting a count or strength.
modes.example: is one capsule (<<2>>50 mg) per day
